evidence.finding: The recursive sequence is stated plainly and linked to concrete projects. The page explicitly distinguishes an analytical pattern from structural equivalence and current proficiency.

Three October 2026 accounts describe clarification and revision leading to physical labels, participation instruments producing written records, and an editorial brief leading to revised cuts and publication.

The account supports seven recorded sittings, edition separation, three clarification questions, a revised proof, fifty label-to-audio links, and retrospective physical-use confirmation. Visitor use and final acceptance remain outside its support.

Written participation and editorial animation are separate bounded accounts. Neither preparation nor publication is promoted into proof of every safeguard, exact file identity, audience impact, or sole authorship.

The historical sequence joins gathering-derived needs, a keyword-community model, natural-language entry, organizer use, support, and independent continuation routes. The 2026 return remains a limited threshold.
Administrative categories become resident issue pathways and public guidance. The implementation is dated and explicitly archived; public interactions do not establish present service use.
The lab separates meaning, evidence, and custody, shows a concrete date correction, and labels its reader-return prototype synthetic and its client sprint proposed.
The service model and before-and-after collection evidence support historical delivery. The About comparison expressly leaves the finer resident-feedback-to-redesign history unresolved.

Bound browser observations record home → Work → Technical Operations, matching rendered paragraph hashes and visible citation targets after explicit disclosure at both widths. These observations do not corroborate the underlying project accounts.
